name: Should I include a bathroom with my extra bedroom addition?
description: Include a bathroom if you need private guest or in-law quarters, but omit it if nearby bathrooms suffice and you want to reduce plumbing and waterproofing costs

mainEntity.name: Should I include a bathroom with my extra bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to add an attached bathroom to an extra bedroom depends on how you plan to use the room and your plumbing budget. If the addition will serve as a guest suite, in-law quarters, or primary bedroom, an attached bathroom provides privacy and convenience. However, adding a bathroom requires trenching, drainage connections, fixture installations, and waterproofing, which adds substantial plumbing and tile work to the build. If an existing hall bathroom is nearby and easily accessible, you can reduce construction scope by omitting plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include a bathroom if you need private guest or in-law quarters, but omit it if nearby bathrooms suffice and you want to reduce plumbing and waterproofing costs.
